## Changes / 改动

Describe the change and its reason / 说明改动及原因。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] I ran relevant checks and recorded actual results / 已运行相关检查并记录实际结果。
- [ ] No credentials, user data or unrelated generated outputs / 无凭据、个人数据及无关生成物。
- [ ] For fan charts, I also completed the [fan-chart checklist](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/fan-chart.md) below / 社区谱面请补全专用清单。

### Fan-chart checklist / 社区谱面清单（适用时填写）

- [ ] Licence evidence for audio and optional cover is linked in info.json and CREDITS.md.
- [ ] Chart author and all resource authors are credited; I can grant CC BY-SA 4.0 for my chart data.
- [ ] Any conversion includes the original mapper's permission_url, or this is not a conversion.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_fan_chart.py <slug>` passed locally; Markdown result attached.
- [ ] I played the chart myself and disclosed any script-tier plugins for maintainer review.
